title: Polarized IKKT holography: bulk realization of BPS operators
abstract: We study the holographic imprint of polarization in the lowest BPS multiplet of the IKKT matrix model. On the matrix model side, the deformation requires operator mixing and broken-symmetry Ward identities to organize the surviving operators into an irreducible atypical multiplet of the $F(4)$ superalgebra. In the bulk, we use one-dimensional maximal gauged supergravity to identify the analytic half-BPS background with $F(4)$ symmetry whose boundary behavior matches the IKKT polarization. We solve the linearized bosonic and fermionic equations around this background and its undeformed counterpart exactly, and extract the independent asymptotic data. The supersymmetry transformations of these data reproduce the matrix model multiplets, thus establishing a bulk realization of this BPS operator structure.
summary:
1. 作者研究极化如何重组IKKT最低BPS多重态，在一维极大规范超引力中给出边界行为匹配极化的半BPS背景及全部物理线性涨落的解析解。
2. 经Konishi算符混合、破缺对称性的Ward关系及单态解耦，152个玻色态与144个费米态组成F(4)非典型不可约多重态，其超对称变换由体渐近数据精确复现。
3. 两组对偶的渐近多重态提供了算符与源的候选数据，为全息重整化及BPS关联函数计算奠定基础。

title: BMS Charges from Null Hypersurfaces
abstract: We show how the gravitational dynamics, phase space and Noether charges of the BMS group at future null infinity $\mathscr{I}^+$ can be derived as limits of their analogues on null hypersurfaces at finite distance. The Bondi mass-loss and angular-momentum evolution equations arise as limits of the Raychaudhuri and Damour constraints. The Ashtekar--Streubel (aka Wald--Zoupas) symplectic potential arises as a specific member of a two-parameter family of null-boundary symplectic potentials, corresponding to the Dirichlet (aka canonical) polarization, while the other members differ by field-space exact terms, leading to the same radiative pre-symplectic structure but potentially different BMS fluxes. Deriving the BMS charges requires additional care, since BMS generators extended into the bulk are generally not tangent to the null hypersurfaces. After accounting for this and the associated anomalies, the renormalized canonical charges still contain an additional soft contribution. The prescription of a covariant boundary Lagrangian determines a corner improvement that removes this term and recovers the standard BMS charges.
summary:
1. 作者从有限距离类光超曲面的渐近极限，推导出未来类光无穷远的邦迪质量损失、角动量演化方程及辐射相空间。
2. 计入BMS生成元的非切向分量与反常并扣除闵氏背景后，边界拉格朗日量的协变性确定角点改进，消去狄利克雷荷中的软项，恢复标准BMS荷及通量平衡律。
3. 在截面首阶度规固定为圆球度规的相空间中，两参数辛势族共享辐射预辛结构，边界与角点代表元提供确定协变引力荷所需的信息。

title: Banana D-modules
abstract: We study the holonomic $D$-module whose solutions are generic-mass banana Feynman integrals with complex propagator powers and spacetime dimension. We call this the banana $D$-module. Two properties of the banana $D$-module are studied: its holonomic rank and the irreducibility of the monodromy representation. This is achieved by relating the banana $D$-module to Lauricella $F_{C}$ hypergeometric systems. Further, we expand the generic-mass banana Feynman integral and the associated discontinuity integral in terms of series solutions. Finally, we analyze the Pfaffian system arising from the banana $D$-module and construct an explicit $d\log$ representation in the equal-mass specialization.
summary:
1. 作者将任意圈数、复维数与复传播子幂次的一般质量香蕉费曼积分关联到Lauricella超几何系统，构造局部解基及积分与不连续性的级数展开。
2. 对含n条内线的图，证明D模秩恒为2^n−1，且当任一非空参数子集之和均非整数时，单值群表示不可约。
3. 这些结果确立了解空间维数与主积分计数的一致性，并在等质量、传播子幂次为一时给出任意圈数的显式dlog微分系统。

title: The Kerr Metric in Canonical Harmonic Coordinates to All Orders
abstract: We give in closed form the transformation from Boyer--Lindquist coordinates to the canonical harmonic coordinates of the Kerr metric, to all orders in Newton's constant and in the spin. This is the canonical harmonic chart selected by the MPM prescription and by the harmonic-gauge Einstein recursion sourced by the Kerr multipoles, with the residual homogeneous freedom fixed by the boundary conditions. The chart is the real, time-reversal-covariant combination of the two radial harmonic functions underlying the Cook--Scheel coordinates, which differ from it by a definite residual harmonic transformation. The proof rests on a classification of the residual harmonic freedom. Rotational covariance, parity, time reversal and analyticity in the spin allow a decaying homogeneous solution beyond the linear field only in the spatial components at third post-Minkowskian order, with angular degree $\ell=p+2$ at spin order $a^p$. This sector is a pure gauge mode, equivalent to an MPM gauge moment. The exact chart selects the representative in which this third-PM homogeneous mode vanishes; imposing the same condition on the recursion removes the only residual ambiguity and fixes its solution uniquely. As a consequence, the canonical MPM iteration needs no finite-part regularisation and no harmonicity correction at any order. We give the exact gothic metric and the post-Minkowskian coefficients in closed form through fifth order, where an arctangent function first appears at fourth order. We find agreement with recent canonical MPM and amplitude-based results at fourth order, and we verify the construction in exact arithmetic through fifth order and twelfth order in the spin, with code made publicly available.
summary:
1. 针对克尔外场的谐和规范歧义，作者给出从博耶—林德奎斯特坐标到典范谐和坐标的闭式变换，对牛顿常数与自旋均精确至全阶。
2. 在旋转协变、宇称、时间反演与自旋解析性约束下，线性阶后的独立衰减齐次自由度仅存于后闵氏三阶的空间分量，置零该纯规范扇区即唯一固定递推解。
3. 这建立了克尔多极矩驱动的递推与典范多极后闵氏构造的全阶等价性，并证明后者在任意阶均无需有限部分正则化及谐和性修正。

title: Cosmological Correlators with Triple Massive Exchanges
abstract: Among all tree-level contributions to the primordial bispectrum, the triple exchange of massive scalars is the most challenging. In this paper we present an analytical formula for this bispectrum in the form of a double series, which allows the three exchanged fields to have different masses and converges throughout the whole physical region. We obtain it by expanding the mixed propagator with the softest momentum, so that the triple exchange becomes a sum of integrals over two mixed propagators. Each of these integrals satisfies a differential equation and is fixed by its value at equal momentum. We further show that the squeezed limit follows directly from this formula and takes a simple and compact form.
summary:
1. 作者在弱混合领阶展开最软动量的混合传播子，解析计算了三个质量可不同的标量场经三次耦合产生的原初双谱三重交换贡献。
2. 所得双级数在包括挤压与折叠极限的全部物理动量区域收敛，系数完全确定，并在所检验构型中与数值积分一致。
3. 挤压极限的对数振荡频率分别由各重场质量决定，异质量信号叠加形成调制，为从原初非高斯性提取暴胀多场质量信息提供了解析依据。

title: Bulk Wilson Loops from $\mathscr{I}$
abstract: A Carrollian description of four-dimensional Yang-Mills theory on partially complexified future null infinity was recently proposed by Opreij, Skinner and Wang in arXiv:2604.09771 . In this paper, we give a new form of the Carrollian Yang-Mills kinetic action on real future null infinity, and recover the logarithmic two-point function found by arXiv:2604.09771 . We then extend the Carrollian description of Yang-Mills beyond scattering amplitudes by studying the expectation value of a null polygonal Wilson loop in Minkowski spacetime. We propose a boundary operator given by the trace of a cyclic product of holomorphic frames on the good cuts associated with the polygon's vertices. At order $g^2$, we show analytically that the boundary calculation reproduces the rational bulk integrand obtained from a self-dual Lagrangian insertion.
summary:
1. 针对四维闵氏时空杨–米尔斯理论中类光多边形Wilson环的边界重构，作者在实未来零无穷远以希尔伯特变换重写辐射场动能项，并提出顶点对应良好截面上全纯标架循环乘积之迹作为边界算符。
2. 新动能项恢复对数两点函数，边界计算在$g^2$阶经赝极点相消，解析重现自对偶拉格朗日量插入所得的体内有理被积函数。
3. 这一匹配将卡罗尔描述从散射振幅拓展至不依赖渐近态的非局域体观测量。

title: Brane Tilings and Polygons with Two Interior Points
abstract: We fully classify the brane tilings and the 4d N=1 supersymmetric quiver gauge theories corresponding to toric Calabi-Yau 3-folds whose toric diagrams are convex lattice polygons with two interior lattice points. There are 45 such polygons up to GL(2,Z) transformations and lattice translations: 5 triangles, 19 quadrilaterals, 16 pentagons and 5 hexagons. We identify all 323 toric phases corresponding to these toric Calabi-Yau 3-folds. For every toric phase, we present the brane tiling with its quiver and superpotential, the perfect matching matrix and the F- and D-term charge matrices. For each brane tiling, we study the mesonic moduli space of the corresponding abelian 4d N=1 theory through its Hilbert series and plethystic logarithm, and identify its generators and their leading relations. We also identify the mesonic global symmetry for each brane tiling and determine the superconformal U(1)R charges.
summary:
1. 作者完整分类了托里克图为含两个内部格点的凸格多边形的卡拉比–丘三维簇所对应的膜铺砌与四维N=1超对称箭图规范理论。
2. 在GL(2,Z)变换及格平移下，45类多边形对应全部323个托里克相，逐相给出了箭图、超势、完美匹配矩阵及F项和D项电荷矩阵。
3. 各阿贝尔理论的介子模空间生成元及首阶关系、介子整体对称性和超共形R荷均获确定，系统刻画了这类理论的真空几何与对称结构。

title: On a Supersymmetric Generalization of the Matytsin Formula
abstract: We derive the leading asymptotics of the supersymmetric analogue of the Itzykson-Zuber integral for the supergroup $U(n|m)$ in the limit $n,m\to\infty$ when $n/m$ is kept finite. This generalizes the Matytsin result for $U(N)$. We show that it is described by the classical action of two independent Hamiltonian systems corresponding to the bosonic and fermionic sectors.
summary:
1. 在正则连续谱假设下，作者由径向热方程推导了超群U(n|m)的Itzykson–Zuber积分在n、m趋于无穷且n/m固定时的首阶渐近式。
2. 积分模的对数具有n²标度，其首阶泛函由玻色、费米两套独立哈密顿系统的经典作用量及显式边界项构成。
3. 正则变换将两扇区的混合对数耦合归入边界项，使动力学归结为复Hopf方程，将Matytsin的集体场描述推广至超对称情形。

title: Reset Quantum Channels
abstract: We introduce Reset Quantum Channels (RQCs), a class of quantum channels acting on a Hilbert space structured as a direct sum of an arbitrary number of subspaces. Within each subspace, the state evolves unitarily; across subspaces, it is transferred by measure-and-prepare resets along given states. In this general setting, we show that the determination of their invariant states reduces to a stochastic eigenvalue problem, whose size is set by the number of reset states rather than by the dimension of the Hilbert space, and we discuss the uniqueness of these states. We further address the primitivity and the spectrum of these channels, which we compute explicitly when the reset states commute with the unitary evolutions. Applications include a small system coupled to several thermal reservoirs. We also consider random unitary evolutions and analyze the averages of the invariant states in this setup. Finally, we show that a suitable continuous-time limit yields Lindblad generators of reset type on the algebra of block-diagonal operators.
summary:
1. 作者针对相干演化与随机重置共同作用下的稳态问题，构建了直和子空间内幺正演化、子空间间测量—制备转移的量子信道。
2. 在各子空间重置概率非零时，作者将稳态求解严格约化为随机矩阵的不变向量问题，两子空间情形的阶数仅为两组重置态数目的较小值，并给出唯一性条件。
3. 该框架显式给出小系统耦合多热库的稳态，并通过块对角算符代数上的适当连续时间极限，建立与重置型Lindblad动力学的联系。

title: Scattering by two parallel semi--infinite arrays of sound--soft scatterers
abstract: This article considers the scattering of an acoustic wave by two identical semi--infinite arrays of point scatterers which are positioned parallel to one another. The resulting system of scattering coefficients is formulated as a pair of coupled discrete Wiener--Hopf equations with a full $2\times2$ matrix kernel composed of two scalar kernel functions that represent interaction within the selected array and between the two arrays. Exploiting the symmetry of the two arrays, we introduce symmetric and antisymmetric components of the scattering coefficients, which decouple the matrix Wiener--Hopf system into two independent scalar problems with kernels given by the sum and difference of the two original kernel functions. The scalar Wiener--Hopf equations are then solved using the Wiener--Hopf technique in a very similar way to what has previously been used to solve the semi--infinite array problem. The original definitions of the two scalar kernels are represented by a lattice sum and practical evaluation techniques are discussed. Comparisons with previous work are also critically discussed. The resulting formulation provides an exact analytical solution to a coupled semi--infinite array problem and illustrates how symmetry can reduce a discrete matrix Wiener--Hopf problem to two scalar problems.
summary:
1. 作者在小散射体的Foldy近似下，求得两条相同、端点对齐的平行半无限声软阵列对声波多重散射的精确解析解。
2. 交换对称性将2×2矩阵Wiener–Hopf方程化为两个独立标量问题，入射相位差为偶、奇数倍π时分别产生纯对称、纯反对称散射场。
3. 该解为多阵列散射算法提供解析基准，并验证既有方法在所考察算例中随截断长度增加而收敛，最大误差集中于截断端。

title: Moments, Equilibrium Equations and Barycentric Coordinates
abstract: In a previous article, we applied the classical theory of moments to establish equilibrium equations for rather general finite systems of interacting particles. An equilibrium of such a system occurs if and only if the corresponding ``zeroth'' moment $\mu_0$ and the first moment $\mu_1$ vanish. Our focus then was on the relationship between $\mu_0$, $\mu_1$ and the second moment $\mu_2$ in order to produce systems of equilibrium equations solely dependent on mutual distances, including a generalization of the Albouy-Chenciner equations for central configurations in Celestial Mechanics. In the present work, we explore in depth the condition of simultaneously vanishing $\mu_0$ and $\mu_1$ on its own. This condition defines at once a vector space which is studied via barycentric coordinates and elementary exterior algebra, thereby yielding families of equilibrium equations for systems with any consistent number $n$ of particles and dimension $d$. As before, the present equilibrium equations are homogeneous as well as invariant by oriented isometries (for interactions depending only on mutual distances). Our method also develops and extends the approach by A. Albouy from central configurations of codimension $c=(n-1)-d$ equal to one, the so-called Dziobek configurations, to equilibria of systems of interacting particles of arbitrary codimension. Despite the similar appearance, our generalized Albouy equations constitute new equilibrium equations when $c$ is greater than one, even in the case of central configurations. The paper closes with applications to central configurations, with specific results for $n=5,6$ in dimension $d=2$.
summary:
1. 针对总力可由相对位置矢量线性表示的有限粒子系，作者用重心坐标和外代数构造了适用于任意粒子数与维数的平衡方程。
2. 对满足牛顿第三定律的体系，平衡等价于权重矩阵分解为零阶与一阶矩共同核的基矩阵、对称矩阵及基矩阵转置的乘积，将Albouy方法推广至任意余维。
3. 这些方程给出几何对称性约束：正质量平面牛顿五体中心构型中，若三体共线，另两体分居该线两侧且到线等距，则后两体必互为镜像且质量相等。

title: Dynamics of a spherical ferromagnet on a non-conducting incline in an external magnetic field
abstract: Magnetic particles of various shapes and sizes are used in biomedical applications, robotics, nanomagnetism, electrotechnology, and education. Yet despite years of study, a theoretical description of the rolling motion of a solid magnetic sphere still eludes us. One of the reasons is that coupling magnetic fields with mechanical degrees of freedom creates a highly non-linear motion with non-holonomic constraints, which makes modeling these systems analytically or by simulations non-trivial. The Lagrange-d'Alembertian approach to holonomic systems remains one of the most versatile methods to prove central theorems and solve problems in analytical mechanics and electrodynamics. While non-holonomic systems are not accessible by the original theory, recent developments generalize the principle to certain dissipative systems. Here, we present a successful application of these developments to a simple mechanical system comprising a magnetic solid sphere on an incline within an external magnetic field. Using numerical simulations, we characterized how the system depends on its initial parameters. Furthermore, our findings are in line with recent experiments, demonstrating that even very weak magnetic fields can cause unexpected motion of ferromagnetic objects. The simplicity of this example also makes it a promising candidate for undergraduate physics education where the treatment of non-holonomic variational principles is still widely uncommon.
summary:
1. 作者用含耗散的非完整拉格朗日—达朗贝尔方程，数值求解了铁磁实心球在均匀恒磁场中沿绝缘斜面无滑动滚动的动力学。
2. 模拟显示，50微特斯拉量级的磁场即可造成明显横向偏转，磁力矩与重力矩的竞争产生弯曲下滑、扭转、回环及局域振荡。
3. 方位角扫描未呈现磁矩与外场的交换对称性，平面运动的位移—极角响应呈镜像关系，后者源于有效转动自由度降至一个。

title: Comparing weakly interacting and free quantum dynamics locally
abstract: Lieb-Robinson bounds (LRBs) have become a standard tool for perturbative results in quantum many-body physics, including gap stability and many-body adiabatic theory. Here, we use LRBs to locally approximate weakly interacting many-body dynamics with one-body dynamics on large, perturbative time scales. This allows us to use one-body transport results to establish the expected many-body transport behavior on finite time scales in the following two illustrative settings: (i) We prove quantum diffusion, as quantified by a certain operator spreading diagnostic, in weakly interacting and weakly disordered Fermi systems in dimensions $D\geq2$ on large finite time scales based on the non-interacting diffusion result of Black, Drogin, and Hernández [ arXiv:2506.06468 ]. (ii) We show for Fermi-Hubbard models with initially low spin-down density, that all local multi-time spin-up correlation functions are approximated by their free counterparts. In particular, we obtain an OTOC (out-of-time-ordered correlator) counterpart to the patterns of short-time entanglement related to lattice path counts observed numerically by Bippus et al. [Phys. Rev. B 113, 035152 (2026)].
summary:
1. 作者利用Lieb–Robinson界，建立弱相互作用费米多体与自由动力学在长微扰时段的局域比较，误差界不依赖系统体积。
2. 结合单粒子扩散结果，证明二维及以上弱无序、弱相互作用费米体系在有限微扰时段内以高概率呈现时间平均算符扩散。
3. 初态低自旋向下密度还可充当微扰参数，使任意Hubbard耦合强度下全部局域多时自旋向上关联在受控时段内获得自由近似，确立了由初态密度抑制相互作用效应的机制。

title: Quantum Dobrushin comparison and locality of fermionic equilibrium states
abstract: We prove a quantum analogue of Dobrushin's comparison theorem for lattice fermions. As in the classical case, it is a tool for proving uniqueness of equilibrium states, decay of correlations, and stability of local expectations under distant perturbations. We apply it to fermions with weak many-body interactions added to a quadratic Hamiltonian, allowing pairing, spatial inhomogeneity and long-range interactions. If the quadratic Hamiltonian is gapped, there is a coupling strength below which the thermal equilibrium (KMS) state is unique at every positive temperature and its correlations decay uniformly in the temperature. Its local expectations converge to those of the unique gapped ground state exponentially fast in the inverse temperature. In the same regime, local perturbations perturb locally in a strong sense (strong LPPL): every equilibrium state of a system with a distant defect is locally close to the equilibrium state without the defect, however strong or extended the defect is. The same holds for finite-volume Gibbs states with arbitrary even boundary terms. Without a gap, uniqueness, decay of correlations and strong LPPL hold at each positive temperature for interactions below a coupling strength that depends on the temperature. At high temperature, they hold for general interactions.
summary:
1. 作者证明格点费米子的量子Dobrushin比较定理，并应用于弱多体相互作用修正的二次哈密顿量，涵盖配对、空间非均匀及长程相互作用。
2. 二次哈密顿量有隙时，存在温度无关的弱耦合阈值，使所有正温下平衡态唯一、关联衰减对温度一致，局域期望随逆温指数收敛至唯一有隙基态的值。
3. 同一弱耦合区间内，任意强度和范围的远处缺陷所对应的每个平衡态都在局部接近无缺陷平衡态，确立了对远处扰动的强局域稳定性。

title: From Giant Vortex States to Bright Solitons in Rapidly Rotating Bose--Einstein Condensates with Attractive Interactions
abstract: We study the ground state of a Bose--Einstein condensate (BEC) with attractive interaction of strength $ a_\Omega $, confined by a two-dimensional anharmonic trap rotating at angular velocity $ \Omega $. We prove the occurrence of a phase transition, as $ \Omega \to\infty $, from an annular giant vortex state to an angularly localized bright soliton. More precisely, we distinguish three regimes according to the relative sizes of the radial and angular concentration scales. In the weak coupling regime $ a_\Omega = \mathcal{O}({\Omega}^{-1/2}) $, the limiting angular profile is governed by a variational problem on the unit circle showing rotational symmetry breaking: below a given sharp threshold, the condensate remains uniformly distributed in the annulus and has a giant vortex profile with a vortex-free bulk and macroscopic circulation; above it, rotational symmetry is broken. In the intermediate coupling regime $ \Omega^{-1/2} \ll a_\Omega \ll 1 $, the condensate localizes at a point on the unit circle with radial and angular widths of order $ \Omega^{-1/2} $ and $ a_\Omega \sqrt{\Omega})^{-1} $, respectively. After rescaling, the limiting profile factorizes into the ground state of the one-dimensional harmonic oscillator in the radial variable and a one-dimensional bright soliton in the angular variable. In the regime $ a_\Omega = a \in (0,a^*) $, corresponding to stable attraction below the collapse threshold $ a^* $ both the radial and angular widths are of order $ \Omega^{-1/2} $; consequently, the limiting profile is no longer a product but rather a genuinely two-dimensional localized state.
summary:
1. 作者在Gross–Pitaevskii理论中严格证明，二维非谐阱内吸引凝聚体在快速旋转极限下随有效吸引增强，由环形巨涡转为角向局域亮孤子。
2. 圆周有效模型确定旋转对称性破缺的精确阈值及其剩余通量依赖，中等耦合下的重标度轮廓收敛于径向谐振子基态与角向一维亮孤子的乘积。
3. 固定吸引低于坍缩阈值时，两向宽度均为$\Omega^{-1/2}$量级并形成真正二维局域态，揭示聚集尺度匹配所导致的径向与角向耦合。

title: Thermalization and quantum chaos in a pure gauge discrete non-Abelian lattice gauge theory
abstract: Gauge theories constitute the basis of our microscopic description of fundamental physical laws, and they are a cornerstone of contemporary scientific research. Yet, how such systems thermalize far from equilibrium remains a fundamental open question at the crossroads of statistical, high-energy, and condensed-matter physics. In this work, we investigate the thermalization properties of non-Abelian lattice gauge theories, focusing on the discrete gauge group $D_3$, which is ideally suited for current qudit-based quantum simulators. Specifically, we study a linear plaquette chain in a gauge-fixed formulation that removes unphysical degrees of freedom. A numerical analysis of the Hamiltonian spectrum and expectation values of local operators shows a behavior broadly aligned with the Eigenstate Thermalization Hypothesis (ETH). We also study thermalization through the real-time dynamics of the entanglement spectrum, confirming the emergence of random-matrix level statistics after an initial transient. Our results expand the rich phenomenology of dihedral non-Abelian gauge systems. Once the relevant symmetry structure is properly resolved, the model displays the same qualitative ETH-based thermalization scenario observed in Abelian gauge models and generic non-integrable quantum many-body systems.
summary:
1. 为检验非阿贝尔规范约束下的热化，作者对规范固定后的D₃纯规范梯形链引入打破剩余全局对称性的磁项形变，并精确对角化至五个横档。
2. 符合高斯正交系综的参数区随系统尺寸增大而扩展，区内局域算符矩阵元呈现本征态热化特征，淬火后的纠缠谱趋于高斯幺正系综统计。

title: Improved Digitization Bounds for U(1) Lattice Gauge Theory via Semiclassical Analysis
abstract: Simulating lattice gauge theories on a digital quantum computer or using tensor network methods requires a finite-dimensional approximation of the gauge field, a process often called digitization. Controlling the resulting error is essential for assessing the accuracy and resource requirements of these simulations. In this work, we derive a digitization error bound for low-lying eigenstates of the Kogut--Susskind Hamiltonian for pure U(1) gauge theory and translate it into a bound on time-evolution error. Compared with existing bounds, our result achieves exponentially improved dependence on the inverse lattice spacing $1/a$ and evolution time $T$, together with improved dependence on the inverse coupling $1/g$. The key idea is to identify a small parameter in the Kogut--Susskind Hamiltonian and apply tools from semiclassical analysis. Specifically, we adapt Agmon's method to establish exponential decay of the error with the truncation threshold. These results sharpen estimates of the local Hilbert space dimension and qubit resources needed to simulate gauge theories near the continuum limit, at weak coupling, and over long times.
summary:
1. 作者结合局域真空能比较与Agmon半经典估计，证明了纯紧致U(1)格点规范理论低能谱窗内任意态的电场截断及实时演化误差界。
2. 固定体积和激发能窗下，保证给定精度的充分截断阈值对逆晶格间距及演化时间仅呈多对数增长，弱耦合标度由g⁻²改善至附带对数因子的g⁻¹。
3. 这些界收紧了近连续极限、弱耦合和长时间模拟所需的局域希尔伯特空间维数与量子比特资源估计。

title: Entropy production from crossing a quantum separatrix
abstract: If the Hamiltonian of a large quantum system depends on a variable parameter, its parameter-dependent energy spectrum may often form a dense lattice of avoided crossings. If the parameter slowly changes, the system's time evolution through the avoided crossings tends in the semi-classical limit to change from adiabatic to diabatic across a narrow energy range that has recently been defined as a quantum separatrix. Here we show that in the extreme semi-classical limit of a quasi-continuously dense spectrum, all quantum separatrices form a universal one-parameter family, and that evolution through the separatrix becomes efficiently ergodizing. If the unitary evolution is realistically averaged over small variations in the parameter time dependence, quantum separatrix crossing generates diagonal entropy according to a universal formula. Numerical examples confirm that the results for quasi-continuous spectra remain clearly recognizable in finite systems, with only small finite-size effects.
summary:
1. 针对慢驱动系统穿越量子分界区时的对角熵产生，作者在扫速微扰平均及准连续能谱极限下，将密集避免交叉网络归约为单参数普适输运方程。

title: Efficient Tensor Decomposition of the Coulomb and Coulomb-like Potentials and Its Application to Probing Molecular Geometries Using a Quantum Computer
abstract: We present an efficient canonical polyadic decomposition of the Coulomb and Coulomb-like potentials in real-space grid representations suited to quantum computing applications. By decomposing the matrix elements of Coulomb-like potentials into low-rank Cartesian components, we achieve $O(N^{1/3})$ T-gate scaling per Coulomb term, where $N$ is the number of grid points (basis functions) per electron, while maintaining high accuracy. This opens a path to significantly reducing the number of basis functions (i.e., qubits) required compared to previous methods by utilizing improved representations of the Coulomb potential that converge faster with grid spacing. The decomposition is also valid for certain pseudopotentials, which can decrease the cost significantly compared to previous work. This efficient decomposition enables the application of block-encoding techniques at larger grid spacings than with previous decompositions, and can therefore be used for algorithms that do not require high energy accuracy. We apply this decomposed Coulomb potential to hydrogen atom energy levels, the helium ground-state energy, and the Hartree-Fock potential energy curve of LiH, and show that modest basis sizes achieve semi-quantitative to quantitative accuracy. As an example of where these faster-converging Coulomb representations can be used on a quantum computer, we discuss their application to probing low-energy molecular geometries, and we estimate the resulting reduction in the cost of real-time evolution.
summary:
1. 为降低实空间电子结构量子模拟中的库仑势成本，作者对sinc离散变量表示的势核作笛卡尔低秩分解并构造块编码。
2. 秩8分解对氢原子低能级引入约10⁻⁵哈特里的压缩误差，单个库仑项的T门成本为O(N^{1/3})，其中N为每电子网格点数。
3. 该编码使收敛较快的势表示可用于较粗网格上的构型采样，一维模型数值演示了基态滤波对低能核构型的概率增强。

title: Gravity-induced entanglement assisted by an additional interaction using magic angle calibration
abstract: Gravity-induced entanglement provides an operational test of whether gravitational dynamics are compatible with local operations and classical communication (LOCC), but the weakness of the gravitational interaction and the presence of force noise make direct entanglement generation extremely demanding. We introduce a controllable additional coherent interaction that biases two test masses close to, but within, a separability-preservation bound, so that the weak Newtonian coupling supplies only the remaining coherent contribution needed for entanglement. If the additional interaction alone is shown to be incapable of generating entanglement, while entanglement is observed when gravity is included, the gravitational interaction provides a non-LOCC contribution. Since gravity cannot be turned off, we use a magic-angle null of the projected tidal coupling to calibrate the additional interaction and force noise. If the additional dynamics is certified to preserve separability at the magic angle and entanglement is subsequently observed in a non-null configuration, the gravitational contribution is incompatible with an LOCC description within the Markovian model. The protocol trades the stringent absolute force-noise requirement of direct schemes for precision in controlling the additional coupling, its backaction, and angle-dependent systematics.
summary:
1. 作者提出双质量引力纠缠的相干耦合辅助方案，将附加动力学调至可分性保持边界内侧，并用魔角处所选模的潮汐耦合零点校准。
2. 热噪声主导的算例中，约20 dB初始纯态机械压缩支持千倍于无辅助基准的热退相干容限，附加耦合相对容差约为8×10⁻⁴。

title: Scheduling the quantum implementation of the Trotter decomposition for Hamiltonian simulation
abstract: For the quantum computational task for Hamiltonian simulation, the arrangement in which sub-Hamiltonians appear in the Trotter decomposition may have a large influence on the precision, under a given circuit complexity. In this paper, we design several scheduling strategies by combining two methods; that is, the existing simultaneous diagonalization scheme leveraged in order to guarantee the performance in a relatively short circuit depth, with a method inspired from a Trotter-Suzuki decomposition of the second or the fourth order for a better accuracy. By conducting numerical simulations on various Hamiltonian instances, we confirm a systematic advantage over previous methods. Thus, our proposal may eliminate the need of dealing with several Hamiltonian-dependent scheduling strategies.
summary:
1. 针对哈密顿量模拟的精度与电路深度权衡，作者将正反序交替执行与对易项同时对角化、组内CNOT优化结合，构造动态调度。
2. 该方案在相同子幺正操作数下实现二阶误差收敛，氢分子算例中达到同等精度所需电路深度约为200，其他受测方案均超过1000。
3. 四类小规模算例展示的精度—深度优势，为跨分子与自旋模型采用统一调度、减少对哈密顿量专用排序策略的依赖提供了数值依据。

title: Resonance-controlled post-selected mode entanglement in one-dimensional quantum scattering
abstract: We study resonance-controlled post-selected mode entanglement in a one-dimensional quantum-scattering model. Two incoming electrons scatter independently from a symmetric double-barrier structure and the sector with one reflected and one transmitted electron is selected. The idealised delta-function barriers used in earlier work are replaced by exponentially localised cusp barriers, $U(x)=U_0\exp(-|x\mp d/2|/a)$, for which the single-barrier scattering problem is exactly solvable in terms of modified Bessel functions of imaginary order. We derive the corresponding reflection and transmission amplitudes, verify their current normalisation and validate them independently by direct numerical integration. Two separated cusp barriers are then combined through a Fabry-Pérot composition, whose accuracy is quantified by solving the full two-centre Schrödinger equation. In the well-separated regime the approximation reproduces the full resonance positions to high accuracy. The concurrence zeros are controlled by the resonance phase condition $\delta(\kappa)+\kappa d=n\pi$, with a continuously unwrapped single-barrier reflection phase $\delta$. We also calculate the post-selection probability $P_{RT}$, showing explicitly that large conditional concurrence can occur in a low-probability sector. Systematic scans in barrier width, integrated strength and reference momentum show that finite width can shift off-resonant concurrence maxima and, depending on the reference momentum, reduce their attainable height. The results identify resonance-controlled conditional entanglement as a robust feature of the well-separated double-barrier geometry rather than an artefact of the zero-range idealisation.
summary:
1. 作者结合单尖峰势垒精确解与双中心数值计算，刻画两个同自旋电子独立散射于有限宽度对称双势垒后的一反射一透射后选择模纠缠。
2. 势垒充分分离时，恰有一个入射动量处于全透射共振使并发度归零；有限宽度可移动非共振峰，并依参考动量降低峰高。
3. 结果确立了共振调控机制在有限宽度下的稳健性，并揭示弱势垒算例中高条件纠缠可伴随约10⁻⁴的后选择概率。

title: Generalized Wigner-Yanase Uncertainty Bounds for Multiple Quantum Channels
abstract: We derive uncertainty relations for quantum channels based on the generalized Wigner-Yanase skew information. For three channels, we obtain a product lower bound by optimizing over permutations of commutator and anticommutator pairings. For an arbitrary number of channels, we establish a lower bound on the sum of squared uncertainties and construct a hierarchy of bounds using the partial Cauchy-Schwarz inequality. These bounds are invariant under changes of Kraus representation for a fixed operator basis. The first two levels of the hierarchy coincide with the elementary arithmetic-geometric mean bound, while the intermediate levels generally depend on the ordering of the operator basis. Examples involving three and four qubit channels demonstrate the bounds and compare their performance with an earlier pairing inequality under fixed channel representations.
summary:
1. 作者基于广义Wigner–Yanase偏斜信息，证明了给定输入态下置换优化的三信道不确定性乘积下界与任意多信道的平方和下界。
2. 平方和下界层级从算术—几何平均界单调递减至对易子界，三、四个单比特信道在文中参考参数及算符基下的p=2级较末级分别提高70.0%和88.5%。
3. 这些结果确立了与Kraus表示无关的多信道不确定性约束，其中端点还与算符基无关，中间层级可依赖算符基及其排序。

title: Pulse-tube-vibration induced Larmor frequency jitter in anisotropic Kramers spins
abstract: We investigate the role of pulse-tube mechanical vibrations towards spin frequency noise in a cryogen-free dilution refrigerator. Our system comprises of a low mode-volume superconducting resonator coupled to 50 ppm $\text{Er}^{3+}:\text{CaWO}_4$ spins with highly anisotropic g-factors. By measuring single-shot spin echoes using narrow-bandwidth three-pulse sequences, we directly observe a vibration induced stochastic signal resulting from the spin's Larmor frequency moving into and out of the detection bandwidth. The sensitivity to these vibrations is substantially suppressed when a) the external magnetic field is aligned along the symmetry c-axis and b) spin temperature is modestly increased to 60~mK. We also benchmark the system as a quantum sensor for angular fluctuations, extracting a noise floor of 350 nanodegrees.
summary:
1. 作者用窄带三脉冲回波直接观测到，脉管振动经g因子各向异性，将Er³⁺:CaWO₄晶轴相对磁场的角涨落转化为拉莫尔频率抖动。
2. 方差拟合给出10毫秒延迟下约5×10⁻⁴度的角抖动标准差，沿c轴施场或升温至60毫开尔文均显著压低回波幅度涨落。
3. 结果识别了该体系的机械退相干通道，并以约350纳度的角噪声底展示了各向异性克拉默斯自旋探测微小角涨落的能力。

title: Consecutive Supersymmetric Quantum Mechanical Algorithms for Resolving the Spectra of Legendre-type Differential Operators
abstract: Quite comprehensive iterative algorithms based on consecutive supersymmetric quantum mechanics (SUSYQM) have been constructed heuristically, for resolving the eigenspectra of the Legendre operator and its associates parametrized in various coordinates, \emph{without receiving any input from traditional analytical methods}. On building these algorithms, the two symmetries \text{--} supersymmetry and shape invariance symmetry \text{--} hidden in these operators are brought to the fore as the only two governing principles, with the aids of the newly devised algebraic techniques such as the \emph{active supersymmetrization transformations}, \emph{momentum operator maps} as well as plain and \emph{higher-order spin matrix maps}. In view of their algebraic simplicity and elegance, high efficiency, as well as independence of traditional methods, some of these algorithms become the promising candidates to supplant the popular power series approach to the eigenspectra of Legendre-type operators.
summary:
1. 作者针对不同坐标参数化下勒让德及其连带微分算符的本征谱，启发式构造了基于逐次超对称量子力学的迭代求解算法。
2. 算法仅以超对称性和形状不变性为支配原则，借助主动超对称化、动量算符映射与高阶自旋矩阵映射，无需传统解析方法的输入即可求解。
3. 其简洁的代数结构和高效率，使其中部分算法成为替代幂级数法求解勒让德型算符谱的候选方案。

title: Symplectic Matroids, Stabilizer Codes, and Quantum Secret-Sharing
abstract: An $\mathbb{F}_q$-linear $[[n,k]]_q$ stabilizer code is represented by a totally isotropic subspace of $\mathbb{F}_q^{2n}$ of dimension $n-k$, whose full-rank generator matrix has nonzero maximal minors on admissible column sets forming the bases of a representable symplectic matroid. Sarvepalli asked whether graphical symplectic matroids introduced by Chow give stabilizer codes with good parameters, when a Lagrangian matroid induces a quantum access structure, which code realizes it, and which polynomial carries the weight enumerator. We answer these questions. For a $3$-connected simple graph, every representation of a graphical symplectic matroid, over any field, gives a stabilizer code of distance exactly $2$, so the girth is not a lower bound. For a represented Lagrangian matroid and a dealer, we construct the dealer-shortened stabilizer code, its logical operators, an encoding isometry and explicit recovery maps, and we show that this is the code implemented by the stabilizer state through teleportation. A set of players recovers the secret, learns nothing, or learns part of it according to a rank formula on pairs of columns, which equals its mutual information with the dealer; for graph states it becomes a cut-rank condition. Over $\F_2$ a symplectic matroid of any rank has only one representation, so the code, its access structure and its weight enumerators depend on the matroid alone; for $q\ge3$ even the enumerator does not. Circuit-induced authorized sets always reconstruct when the matroid is self-dual, but not in general, and a six-qubit graph state shows that the two access structures can differ even then. Finally, a polynomial in the ranks of column pairs determines both weight enumerators.

title: Trotter Error Bounds in Lean 4 with a Cancellation-Aware Analysis of the Fourth-Order Suzuki Formula
abstract: We formalize the commutator-scaling bound of Childs et al. in Lean 4. For skew-adjoint generators, the local order condition gives an explicit integer step count sufficient to meet a prescribed error tolerance. We apply the theorem in Lean to the binary fourth-order Suzuki formula. For this formula we can also account for cancellation within and between steps. Using local remainder estimates of Casas and Murua, we sum the signed quintic and centered seventh-degree error terms after conjugating each to the interaction picture. For every positive integer step count, we bound the difference between this sum and the global error operator. At fixed time the explicit remainder is eighth order in the step size, and the integral of the conjugated quintic term gives the exact leading error coefficient. The Lean proofs cover the two-generator finite-sum estimates, including the spectral norm for complex matrices. On five ten-site nearest-neighbor Heisenberg instances at time $10$ and tolerance $10^{-3}$, the transported sum meets the tolerance at a mean of $129.4$ steps. Taking a separate norm at each step with the same polynomial and remainder gives a mean first crossing between $184.6$ and $185.2$ steps. The accumulated Casas--Murua local bound at $q=8$ gives a mean of $184.8$ steps.

1. 作者在Lean 4中形式化验证哈密顿量模拟的对易子误差界，并为双项四阶Suzuki公式建立保留步内与步间抵消的全局界。
2. 七次误差项在相互作用绘景求和后，固定时间余项为步长八阶；五个十位点最近邻海森堡样本在时间10、容差10⁻³下平均129.4步达标，较逐步取范数减少约30%。
3. 五次项的输运积分确定全局误差的精确首项系数，其中能量对角分量线性累积，非对角分量可经能隙相位抵消。

title: The inverted harmonic oscillator in Segal-Bargmann space: Time-asymmetric propagator reconstruction and bi-coherent states
abstract: We investigate the real-time dynamics and resonance quantization of the inverted harmonic oscillator (IHO). Its self-adjoint Hamiltonian on $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ has a real continuous spectrum, while generalized resonance states outside $L^2(\mathbb{R})$ have purely imaginary energies $\pm i\hbar\omega(n+1/2)$. In coordinate space, these states are expressed in terms of complex Hermite polynomials and are biorthonormal under the Fresnel Gaussian pairing. Adapting Moriconi's coordinate-time transformation to the real-time path integral, we derive the exact Feynman propagator. Using Mehler's formula, we show that each discrete expansion alone reconstructs the full unitary kernel on its time half-axis, with the decaying Gamow-Siegert branch converging for $T>0$ and the growing antiresonant branch converging for $T<0$. In the complex-scaled Segal-Bargmann representation, the two Hamiltonians take the form $\pm i\hbar\omega(z(d/dz)+1/2)$, and their monomial eigenfunctions map back to the dual complex Hermite states. The two convergence domains correspond to one-sided contraction semigroups of dilations. Finally, we construct bi-coherent states whose biorthogonal position and momentum second cumulants are purely imaginary and complex conjugate, with product $\hbar^2/4$. The corresponding Heisenberg expectation values follow the exact classical hyperbolic trajectories for arbitrary real initial positions and momenta.

1. 围绕连续实谱倒谐振子的共振动力学，作者以实时间路径积分推导精确传播核，并建立复标度Bargmann表象。
2. 离散共振的衰减支与增长支展开分别仅在正、负时间收敛，各自完整重建幺正传播核，收敛半轴对应单侧收缩半群。

title: geodesiq: a Python package for geometric diabatic-adiabatic optimal state transfer
abstract: We introduce the geodesiq Python package, which implements a geometric framework for shaping control pulses that achieve high-fidelity state transfer in multilevel quantum systems. The underlying method combines adiabatic and diabatic control into a single metric, suppressing unwanted excitations while allowing selected diabatic passages. Finding the pulse thereby reduces to solving a single first-order ordinary differential equation. We explain how to use geodesiq and illustrate its use explicitly with Landau-Zener transitions, spin-qubit initialization, adiabatic many-body ground-state preparation, and a diabatic-adiabatic transfer in a four-level system.

title: Communication advantages of a quantum switch of two pure-loss channels
abstract: The quantum switch can enable communication through otherwise unusable channels, a phenomenon known as causal activation. We show that a switch of two identical pure-loss channels can achieve strictly greater energy-constrained classical and quantum capacities than their sequential use, even when two-way classical communication is available. Remarkably, the switch also activates quantum communication over a range of transmissivities for which the sequential channel has zero quantum capacity.

2. 单信道透射率满足0≤λ<1时经典容量、0<λ<1时双向辅助量子容量严格提高，且在λ*<λ≤1/√2（λ*≈0.70577576）激活串联时为零的无辅助量子容量。
3. 控制比特携带的光子损耗信息提供了额外通信资源，使因果激活在连续变量有损信道中得到确立。

title: Block Search Conditioned on Features for Sequential Quantum Data Encoding
abstract: Sequential quantum data encoding is addressed through the joint selection of input features and encoding blocks within a fixed quantum register. At each step, a new feature, a block of operations, its placement, and its rotation weights are selected together from training data, extending the incremental construction of Q-FLAIR. With direct-loss selection (RAW), nine to twelve features were retained in four qubits across five new Bars and Stripes datasets. Under the same final calibration, mean changes relative to the calibrated Q-FLAIR reference were +5.53 percentage points in balanced accuracy, -15.83% in binary cross-entropy (BCE), and +7.79% in area under the ROC curve (AUC). The prespecified success criterion was met in four of five datasets and for the mean paired differences. These results were obtained by comparing complete procedures under a common cap of 32 operations.
summary:
1. 针对固定寄存器的多特征编码，作者联合筛选新特征、双操作模块、位置及旋转权重，构建四量子比特顺序编码电路。
2. 在五组新生成的含噪4×4条纹图像数据上，以32次操作为上限并统一末端校准，直接损失筛选较Q-FLAIR平均提高平衡准确率5.53个百分点、降低交叉熵15.83%。
3. 所选电路用18—24次操作编码9—12个特征，展示了在固定量子比特数和有限操作预算下扩展输入容量的具体实现。

title: Criterion and Construction Framework for Impure Quantum $(r,δ)$-LRCs from Optimal $(r,δ)$-LRCs
abstract: This paper aims to uncover new phenomena and provide new tools for quantum \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs derived from optimal \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs. The initial motivation is to identify the main reason for the existence of impure cases in such quantum codes. Our main result reveals that whether \(d = r+1\) is the key factor governing the impurity of quantum \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs. We prove that, when \(d \neq r+1\), impure quantum codes derived from optimal \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs have bounded lengths. Conversely, when \(d = r+1\), we construct impure quantum \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs with unbounded lengths. The central tool developed in this work is a criterion for identifying impure quantum codes derived from optimal \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs. The main results include a criterion for impurity in quantum \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs (Theorem 3.2), a construction framework for impure quantum \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs (Theorem 4.4), and two families of impure quantum \((r,\delta)\)-LRCs (Theorems 4.8 and 4.11).
summary:
1. 作者针对最优经典(r,δ)局部可恢复码诱导量子码的非纯性，建立了适用于欧氏或厄米对偶包含母码的参数判据与构造框架。
2. 固定r、δ及经典距离d时，d≠r+1的非纯码码长有界；在δ<d=r+1<2δ下，作者构造出两族码长无界、量子距离恰为2δ的非纯码。
3. 这些构造中最低权重经典码字均属于对偶子码，使量子纠错距离严格超过母码距离，揭示了局部恢复约束下非纯性带来距离增益的机制。

title: Ancilla-Free Exact Dicke-State Synthesis with Optimal Size and Depth
abstract: We construct exact circuits for $n$-qubit Dicke states of any Hamming weight $k$ using $O(n)$ single-qubit gates and CNOTs in $O(\log n)$ depth without ancillary qubits. The gate count and depth are asymptotically optimal for every $0<k<n$. We compress symmetric blocks to free output qubits for weight-dependent phases. A sign correction followed by a collective rotation produces a state whose overlap with the target is at least a positive constant, so exact amplitude amplification takes $O(1)$ steps. For balanced Dicke states ($k=\lfloor n/2\rfloor$), the logarithmic depth disproves the $\Omega(k)$ depth lower bound conjectured by Yuan and Zhang (2025).
summary:
1. 作者构造了任意激发数k的n量子比特Dicke态精确制备电路，通过对称分块压缩在输出寄存器内实现权重依赖相位，无需辅助量子比特。
2. 符号校正与集体旋转保证常数重叠下界，使精确振幅放大仅需常数次，总计使用O(n)个任意单比特门与CNOT、O(log n)深度，对0<k<n均渐近最优。
3. 平衡Dicke态的对数深度构造推翻了Ω(k)深度下界猜想。

title: Emergent Causality of Macroscopic Transport and Equilibration in Long-Range Quantum Systems
abstract: Long-range couplings in quantum many-body systems challenge conventional notions of locality and causality. Here, we show that macroscopic particle transport nevertheless exhibits emergent causality --- an effective light cone that becomes strict in the thermodynamic limit. For power-law hopping with a decay exponent $\alpha\in(D,D+1)$ in $D$ spatial dimensions, the emergent causality cone expands super-ballistically, and we establish that its scaling is optimal. Our results imply lower bounds on the equilibration time of long-range systems. Finally, we construct an example of a long-range free-fermion chain with $\alpha\in (1,3/2)$, whose macroscopic density equilibrates super-ballistically, i.e., in a time sub-linear in the system size. While long-range interactions are usually associated with slow equilibration due to increased energy barriers, our example demonstrates that long-range hopping can lead to accelerated equilibration.
summary:
1. 作者对含任意密度依赖相互作用的D维幂律跃迁系统（衰减指数α>D）证明了宏观输运因果界，并导出需宏观粒子重分布时的平衡时间下界。
2. D<α<D+1时，光锥d∝t^{1/(α−D)}的标度最优，锥外输运概率随转移粒子数指数衰减，使宏观因果性在热力学极限严格成立。
3. 构造的1<α<3/2长程自由费米链在固定密度下对任意初态均以O(L^{α−1/2}ln L/J₀)时间尺度实现宏观密度平衡，证明长程跃迁可将平衡加速至次线性时间。

title: Detection of genuine multipartite entanglement by means of entanglement monotones
abstract: We look for pure state entanglement monotones that may serve as certificates of a strong form of genuine multipartite entanglement, that we refer to as irreducible entanglement: a $D$-partite state (with $D\geq 3$) is irreducibly $D$-partite entangled if it cannot be decomposed as a product of states that are at most $(D-1)$-partite entangled. We start by establishing a no-go result proving that no reasonable genuine multipartite entanglement entropy can simultaneously obey LOCC-monotonicity and subadditivity. After relaxing the first condition to LO-monotonicity, we provide a simple method generating genuine multipartite entanglement monotones with the desired properties. Focusing on a subfamily of these monotones, we show that they are able to detect any form of genuine tripartite entanglement in three-qubit systems.
summary:
1. 针对不能分解为低阶纠缠态张量积的多体纯态纠缠，作者证明：非负、次可加且在双可分态上为零的LOCC单调量在所有谱超图张量态上均为零。
2. 将单调性放宽至局域操作后，作者用迹不变量构造可加判据，其正值认证不可约多体纠缠，并与三量子比特纯态的真正三体纠缠等价。
3. 对Haar随机纯态，这些判据随局域维数增大依概率趋零，揭示了高维纠缠认证信号的渐近衰减。

title: Full-chip constrained quantum annealing via self-calibrating spin-susceptibility control
abstract: Discrete optimization in finance, power grids, and logistics requires minimizing Ising Hamiltonians under coupled linear constraints. However, quadratic-penalty formulations generate dense cliques that exhaust the minor-embedding capacity of sparse superconducting processors at 128-176 spins, and first-order dual subgradient schemes diverge or stall under constraint coupling. Accordingly, this study proposes a closed-loop primal-dual scheme, designated as Self-Calibrating Quantum Susceptibility Quasi-Newton (SelfCal-QSQN), in which linear constraints are encoded in longitudinal fields and dual curvature is reconstructed from single-shot spin-fluctuation covariances. This scheme requires no penalty couplers, slack qubits, or perturbation queries. Evaluated over 891 runs on D-Wave Advantage (5,612 qubits) and Advantage2 (4,560 qubits), SelfCal-QSQN achieves 83.3% full-chip exact feasibility, reduces high-constraint error by 6.1-20.1-fold over $K$-scaled first-order updates (138.4-323.3-fold over fixed-gain curvature), outperforms time-matched mixed-integer programming at 256 spins, and attains 95.0%-96.7% feasibility on non-native and inequality benchmarks. Moreover, the scheme is robust toward shot noise and freeze-out drift.
summary:
1. 针对稀疏超导退火器上的耦合线性约束，作者将约束编码于纵场，并以正则化自旋涨落协方差和在线自校准构建闭环拟牛顿控制。
2. 四个重叠等式约束下，4560量子比特全芯片经单比特贪心修整，六次运行中五次获得严格可行解；256自旋高约束数测试的残差较按约束数缩放步长的一阶更新降低6.1—20.1倍。
3. 结果将自旋涨落转化为跨约束响应信息，使约束控制与物理耦合拓扑解耦，绕过平方罚项造成的稠密嵌入瓶颈。

title: Complex chaotic Boltzmann machines as deterministic representations of quantum states
abstract: Neural networks and tensor networks have opened new ways to explore quantum systems by parameterizing families of wave functions through the structure and parameters of a network. Here we extend this perspective to a dynamical representation: we introduce a complex chaotic Boltzmann machine that assigns a deterministic system to a pure quantum state. We extend Suzuki's construction to incorporate both Born probabilities and relative phases. The probabilities set the trajectory velocities in a hypercube, while the phases define a complex field that lifts its Poincare sections. The evolution is determined by the network parameters and initial conditions, without random choices during flights or configuration changes. Our analysis of two qubits and study of three-qubit families show how relations between probabilities organize regular curves, islands, and unstable regions, and how phases distinguish states that share the same Born dynamics. This architecture turns a wave-function parameterization into a geometry of trajectories, providing a tool to explore probabilities, phases, and symmetries together across families of states.
summary:
1. 作者构建复混沌玻尔兹曼机，以玻恩概率设定超立方体轨迹速度、相对相位构成复插值场，确定性表示计算基系数均非零的纯态。
2. 各坐标速度尺度相等且碰撞孤立时，两比特轨迹均为周期轨道；三比特分析显示，重排相同概率权重可改变规则与不稳定结构，相位提升可区分同概率态。
3. 速度及充分的相位记录能够重建波函数，为在统一轨迹几何中研究概率、相位与对称关系提供了完整的态表示。

title: Penalty-Free Constrained Optimization on Dynamic Quantum Circuits via Phase-Protected Tunneling and Closed-Loop Spectral Ratchets
abstract: Embedding hard operational constraints into an unconstrained Hamiltonian via large penalty multipliers induces quadratic spectral aliasing during phase estimation and increases two-qubit gate depth. This paper proposes a penalty-free, closed-loop dynamic quantum circuit scheme, designated as Zeno-decoupled gauge-ratchet optimization (Z-GRO), for constrained binary optimization without outer-loop training. Reversible feasibility phase operators within symmetric dynamical-decoupling echoes confine evolution to the feasible subspace, while an interaction-correlated commutator gauge operator resolves initial symmetry stall. Directional cooling couples the unpenalized objective Hamiltonian to a reusable ancilla with a zero-two-qubit-gate threshold offset, bypassing echoed tunneling gates on retained branches. A survival-filtered Ramsey controller advances the threshold from a linear-programming bound with automatic overshoot rollback. Exact density-matrix and trajectory simulations on spin-glass and quadratic knapsack ensembles show a single-check discrimination gain above four orders of magnitude, improving ground-state probability by factors of 3.0 to 4.3 over quantum Zeno dynamics and 11.4 to 22.5 over penalized schemes. Z-GRO reduces the spin-glass time-to-solution scaling base to 1.529 (compared to 1.684 for quantum Zeno dynamics and 1.909 to 2.047 for penalized schemes) and lowers 14-qubit knapsack time-to-solution by factors of 2.4 to 14.5. For two-qubit gate error rates between $5 \times 10^{-4}$ and $5 \times 10^{-3}$, Z-GRO achieves 2.9 to 7.0 times the optimal probability of noisy penalized feedback, while majority shielding limits loss to 6.3% at a 5.0% readout bit-flip rate, recording 0/24, 0/25, 0/96, 3/25, and 2/80 overshoots.
summary:
1. 为在硬约束二元优化中实现无罚项冷却，作者结合可行性相位回波、对易子驱动和闭环辅助比特谱棘轮，构建无需外环训练的动态量子线路。
2. 理论给出泄漏概率随回波数平方反比下降的渐近上界，八比特自旋玻璃及二次背包模拟的基态概率达到固定调度量子芝诺方案的3.0—4.3倍。
3. 约束保护与目标能谱过滤的分离避免了罚项造成的相位压缩，为利用测量反馈实现可行空间内的耗散寻优提供了物理机制。

title: Tackling Many-Body Coulomb Singularity by Randomization
abstract: Many-body Coulomb dynamics is central to quantum chemistry and molecular simulation, yet the Coulomb singularity undermines both the standard error analysis and performance of product formulas. Even for the simple hydrogen ground state, the celebrated Trotter formulas converge more slowly than their nominal order, and going to higher order does not help. Randomization by itself does not resolve this. We show that conventional qDRIFT suffers the same loss of accuracy, and that for general initial states, the errors of both Trotter formulas and qDRIFT can decrease more slowly than any power of the number of time steps (logarithmically). To overcome these limitations, we introduce supersmoothing qDRIFT, a randomized product formula that turns a physical property of free particle propagation into an algorithmic resource. Our algorithm achieves an error bound that decreases linearly with the time step, uniformly over \textit{all} initial states and without any smoothness or energy assumptions. Combined with spatial discretization analysis, the resulting end-to-end gate count improves on those of qubitization and high-order Trotter formulas applied directly to the discretized Hamiltonian, despite first-order convergence in time. This work demonstrates new ways of utilizing continuum dynamics to achieve algorithmic advantage.
summary:
1. 针对库仑奇点导致的多体量子模拟降阶，作者构造超平滑qDRIFT，保留精确自由传播并随机选择粒子对及相互作用插入时刻。
2. 借助Kato超平滑，作者证明平均输出通道的菱形范数误差上界随步数L按1/L衰减，对所有初态成立且无需正则性或能量假设。
3. 这一连续体机制在初态满足正则性与局域化条件的固定核中性分子中，给出优于直接量子比特化及任意固定阶Trotter相应上界的端到端门数保证。

title: Optimised 8th-Order Trotter-Suzuki Schemes for Quantum Simulation
abstract: Simulating quantum dynamics in many-body systems is one of the most promising applications of quantum computers. Product formulas are a natural choice for this task, since they map directly onto quantum gates, and increasing their order $n$ could lead to reduced gate depths, provided the parameters are chosen efficiently. So far, schemes beyond $6^{\textrm{th}}$ order have only been built as compositions of second-order schemes, while more general product formulas are known only up to $6^{\textrm{th}}$ order. In this work, we extend our optimisation framework to order $n = 8$, and find both more efficient compositions and the first $8^{\textrm{th}}$ order general schemes. Our formulas improve on the theoretical efficiency of the state-of-the-art schemes by Morales et al and we recommend two schemes explicitly. In simulations of the Heisenberg XZ chain one of our recommended schemes always outperforms those by Morales et al, though it is not always the same scheme that performs best. More generally, we observe that for Hamiltonians split into many non-commuting operators the uniformity of a Trotter decomposition becomes the main indicator of a scheme's performance. To assess the schemes' use on quantum hardware, we simulate noisy circuits with our new Qiskit plugin qiskit-omelyan. At current noise levels, the Leapfrog scheme remains the best choice, but as noise rates decrease toward fault tolerance, our recommended schemes become competitive.
summary:
1. 为降低多体长时量子模拟成本，作者通过对易子误差优化，首次构造八阶非复合乘积公式并改进复合方案。
2. 所得21循环方案的定成本理论效率约为已有同循环方案的8倍，六自旋XZ链基准显示局域分组误差主要与参数均匀性相关。
3. 电路模拟中，双比特退极化率为10⁻⁵且采用理想零噪声外推时，八阶方案以约一半门深度实现Leapfrog十分之一的失真率，展示了早期容错长时模拟的潜力。

title: The moments and asymptotic spectral distribution of the Grassmannian ensemble
abstract: In this paper, we study random density matrices constructed by taking partial traces of projections onto random subspaces of a bipartite Hilbert space $\mathcal{H}_A \otimes \mathcal{H}_{B}$ distributed according to the pushforward measure of the action of the unitary group on the Grassmannian $\text{Gr}_{n}(\mathcal{H}_A \otimes \mathcal{H}_{B})$. This ensemble models a `typical' quantum subspace. All tracial moments of the density operator, as well as mixed tracial moments of reduced density operators, are computed explicitly using Weingarten calculus. There are several consequences of these results. In particular, we prove that the empirical spectral distribution of the density operator converges almost surely to a rescaled Marchenko-Pastur law. We also prove that this ensemble can be written as a sum of asymptotically free random density operators, leading to an alternative proof of the convergence of the spectral distribution. Finally, we compute the asymptotic expansion of the average entanglement entropy.
summary:
1. 作者研究Haar随机n维量子子空间归一化投影的约化态ρ，精确求得其全部迹矩与正交诱导组分的混合迹矩，刻画典型子空间的局域谱与熵。
2. 固定n且d_A、d_B趋于无穷、d_A/d_B→c∈(0,∞)时，证明d_Aρ的经验谱依概率收敛于参数c/n的Marchenko–Pastur律，组分经同样缩放后渐近自由。
3. 由此得到平均冯诺依曼熵的渐近式，将Page型结果推广至随机子空间，其中c≤n时平均熵为log d_A−c/(2n)+o(1)。

title: Nonperturbative Bounds on the Ground-State Energy of Lattice QED
abstract: We establish nonperturbative bounds on the ground-state energy of lattice quantum electrodynamics with naive fermions in Coulomb gauge, within the Gaussian photon approximation. Our central result is a spectral comparison theorem showing that, in the thermodynamic limit, the minimum fermionic energy density over all link configurations coincides with that of the trivial gauge configuration. The proof exploits a logarithmic determinant representation and dimensional reduction, without relying on reflection positivity, and applies to lattices of either parity. Combining this result with the positivity of the electromagnetic and Coulomb Hamiltonians, we derive an explicit lower bound on the interacting ground-state energy. Finite-lattice counterexamples show that the thermodynamic limit is essential.
summary:
1. 作者在库仑规范和高斯光子近似下，建立了含朴素费米子的格点QED电中性扇区基态能的非微扰上下界。
2. 通过对数行列式降维，作者证明平庸规范构型在热力学极限下使费米子能量密度最小，并在ma→0时得到相对福克真空的每格点基态能介于约−0.2659q²/a与零之间。
3. 这些界限确立了固定格距下基态能密度的下有界性，并证明其在弱耦合极限趋于福克真空能密度。
